part.text: {"variants": [{"id": "V1", "title": "Probe vs the production judge ensembles", "text": "Probe the autoformalizer's activations for quietly strengthened hypotheses and guessed conventions, as in the original, but judge the probe against the external LLM judges that Goedel-Prover and Kimina actually run — Qwen2.5-72B and QwQ-32B plus their negation-proving and triviality safeguards — rather than against text-only baselines. Train logistic probes on synthetic drift and test on the same 200 human-audited natural misformalizations, reporting whether probe scores beat the judge ensemble's AUROC or flag a complementary error set the judges miss. This turns the result into an adoption decision for Goedel-Prover's Faithfulness-and-Completeness gate and Kimina's semantic-correctness gate instead of an interp demonstration.
